blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-31. At IOTA checkpoint 172877784 (timestamp 2026-07-30 23:13:50 UTC), the immutable VUSD package 0xd3b63e603a78786facf65ff22e79701f3e824881a12fa3268d62a75530fe904f exposes mint/burn, supply-limit, beneficiary, and module-version administration, but no freeze, blacklist, pause, denylist, or holder-transfer hook in its admin, limited_supply, or vusd module function sets; ordinary Move coin transfers therefore have no issuer-selected holder block surface. The inherited stIOTA/vIOTA collateral pools are separate collateral dependencies, not VUSD holder registries. The IOTA EVM address 0x10740259a1860af3327dd0642ee35d6e8e7143ff was re-read at block 12603860 (name Virtue USD, symbol VUSD, decimals 6); the published ERC20Coin implementation exposes vanilla transfer/approve/allowance/transferFrom and delegates account movement to ISC, with no freeze, blacklist, pause, or seize function. The ISC bridge can control cross-chain representation/issuance, but that is route-level mint/burn authority, not selective censorship of existing VUSD holders.

oracleRisk.summary: Virtue's four debt-bearing IOTA Move vaults use one configured oracle rule per collateral. IOTA and iBTC depend on single Pyth feeds with the Pyth State's 60-second stale-price threshold; stIOTA and vIOTA derive their values from their native staking pools and inherit the same single IOTA/USD Pyth path.

branchApplicability.rationale: At IOTA checkpoint 166884205, the VUSD Treasury authorized exactly one current mint module, VirtueCDP. A type-wide query of that module returned exactly four live shared Vault objects, all with nonzero debt supply: IOTA, stIOTA, vIOTA, and iBTC. The oracle package likewise exposed exactly four matching PriceAggregater objects, so each debt-bearing branch is reviewed below.

branches.label: IOTA vault
branches.summary: The IOTA vault uses a one-of-one PriceAggregater whose only accepted rule reads the Pyth IOTA/USD feed.

feeds.path: Pyth IOTA/USD c7b72e5d860034288c9335d4d325da4272fe50c92ab72249d58f6cbba30e4c44 -> sole PythRule weight 1 of threshold 1 -> Virtue IOTA PriceResult

branches.fallbackBehavior: The aggregator has one rule and a threshold of one. Its PythRule calls Pyth get_price, which applies the Pyth State's 60-second stale-price threshold; an unsupported identifier, stale or invalid Pyth result, or missing rule aborts the transaction. No fallback or last-good cache is configured.

collateralParameters.note: Vault 0xaf306be8419cf059642acdba3b4e79a5ae893101ae62c8331cefede779ef48d5; debt cap 5,000,000 VUSD and debt supply 17,604.317760 VUSD at the observation checkpoint.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Authorized liquidator 0xf11c141e6a4c633baa304150c50c85ed66df639c995a1d26aedd5cc235c1f760 may execute the configured below-110%-MCR StabilityPoolRule using a current PriceResult. Pool VUSD offsets debt and receives collateral; the deployed rule charges a 2% protocol fee and 0.5% rebate.
branches.backstop: Shared Stability Pool 0x6101272394511caf38ce5a6d120d3b4d009b6efabae8faac43aa9ac938cec558 held 198,602.895218 VUSD and 195 positions at observation. Its authorized liquidator is 0xf11c141e6a4c633baa304150c50c85ed66df639c995a1d26aedd5cc235c1f760; fee rate is 2% and rebate rate 0.5%. Official docs describe same-transaction flash-mint supplementation when deposits are insufficient.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The reviewed public objects and modules did not establish a separate redistribution or stored-bad-debt route beyond the Stability Pool liquidation/payback flow. AdminCap can change the vault supply limit, liquidation rule/checklists, and pool liquidator; no enforced delay was visible in the reviewed modules.

routes.reviewNote: At IOTA EVM block 12603860 (2026-07-31), eth_call returned name Virtue USD, symbol VUSD, and 6 decimals. The ERC20Coin bytecode delegates balances, total supply, and account movement to the IOTA EVM Magic Contract at 0x1074000000000000000000000000000000000000, and the stored coin type decodes exactly to the configured IOTA Move VUSD type. Virtue documents the native IOTA Mainnet-to-IOTA EVM VUSD bridge. The published ERC20Coin implementation has no independent mint, freeze, blacklist, pause, or seize path, so this is a canonical system-proxy representation rather than an independently issued ERC-20. The route controller is the ISC system contract, not a discretionary issuer key.

controls.label: VUSD IOTA EVM ISC system representation controller

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The representation is not independently issued: the ISC chain custodies the Move VUSD coins deposited into IOTA EVM and the ERC20Coin proxy reads and moves those balances through the Magic Contract at 0x1074000000000000000000000000000000000000, which returned only 7 bytes of code at IOTA EVM block 12825262 because the interface is implemented natively by the ISC runtime rather than in EVM bytecode.
routeChecks.caps: A numeric ceiling exists on the source side and this controller cannot lift it. At IOTA checkpoint 185208700 on 2026-09-01, the VUSD Treasury 0x81f525f4fa5b2d3cf58677d3e39aabc4b0a1ca25cbba605033cfe417e47b0a16 carried exactly one authorized minting module — cdeeb40cd7ffd7c3b741f40a8e11cb784a5c9b588ce993d4ab86479072386ba1::witness::VirtueCDP — with LimitedSupply { limit 50000000000000, supply 5084155147217 } at 6 decimals, i.e. a 50,000,000 VUSD ceiling against 5,084,155.147217 VUSD outstanding. On the destination side at IOTA EVM block 12825262, VUSD 0x10740259a1860af3327dd0642ee35d6e8e7143ff returned name 'Virtue USD', symbol VUSD, decimals 6, no owner(), a zero EIP-1967 implementation slot, and cap(), maxSupply(), mintCap(), supplyCap(), mintingLimit(), totalSupplyCap(), mintingMaxLimitOf(address), mintingCurrentLimitOf(address), maxLimit(), limit(), rateLimit(), and dailyLimit() all reverted — the representation has no independent issuance surface at all, so total representable VUSD stays bounded by the Move-side LimitedSupply that only the Move AdminCap can raise.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The ISC chain committee that operates IOTA EVM is the residual administrator of this route; its current membership, rotation policy, and any chain-level pause were not enumerated from public state and are recorded as unresolved. The ERC20Coin proxy itself exposes no owner, pause, freeze, or upgrade entrypoint.

controls.capDescription: The IOTA EVM representation carries no cap or mint entrypoint of its own; total issuance is bounded by the source-side Treasury LimitedSupply of 50,000,000 VUSD, and only the Move AdminCap — not this route controller — can raise that limit.
bypassSurfaces: The Move AdminCap holder 0xf67d0193e9cd65c3c8232dbfe0694eb9e14397326bdc362a4fe9d590984f5a12 can call set_supply_limit and add_version on the source Treasury; that is Mint Authority exposure, not a capability of this bridge controller.
The ISC committee operating IOTA EVM is an unenumerated validator set for this route.

controls.evidence: Both legs were re-read on 2026-09-01 and neither named RPC blocker materialised: IOTA EVM answered at block 12825262 and IOTA Move at checkpoint 185208700. The destination ERC20Coin at 0x10740259a1860af3327dd0642ee35d6e8e7143ff has no owner, no proxy implementation slot, and no mint, freeze, pause, or seize entrypoint; every one of twelve cap probes reverted. Its route controller is the ISC Magic Contract 0x1074000000000000000000000000000000000000, a native system contract with 7 bytes of EVM code and no discretionary key. On the source side the VUSD Treasury exposes exactly one authorized minting module with a LimitedSupply ceiling of 50,000,000 VUSD against 5,084,155.147217 VUSD of supply, and the AdminCap that can raise it (object 0x38a7b38d0f03338397d1c57f2cc2e3d7c5e3f6fe6887626aacc4cb4e8072c3f5, held by 0xf67d0193e9cd65c3c8232dbfe0694eb9e14397326bdc362a4fe9d590984f5a12) sits in Mint Authority, not in this control. The bridge controller is therefore cap-bounded: it can move representation supply but cannot raise the ceiling that limits it.
